description: This file defines the UserInformation interface which includes methods for accessing user-related data such as default subject and list of subjects, along with associated JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: UserInformation
classes.description: An interface representing user information, including methods for retrieving default subject and list of subjects, and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getDefaultSubject
methods.description: Returns the default subject identifier for the user, if available.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of all subject identifiers associated with the user.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the UserInformation to a JsonObject.

methods.name: toJson with parameters
methods.description: Serializes the UserInformation to a JsonObject considering schema version and field selector.

methods.name: getDefaultSubject
methods.description: Get the default {@link org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies.SubjectId} of the user (the first subject of {@link #getSubjects()}. This authorization subject is also used as default subject when a policy is created.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Get all {@link org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies.SubjectId}s to which the user has access.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Default method to serialize the object to JSON.

methods.name: toJson with parameters
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON with specific schema version and field selection.
